title: Mar bar Rav Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Shabbat 140a, Rav Acha bar Yosef was suffering from heaviness of the heart and consulted Mar Ukva. He later asked in the study hall, where they cited a teaching of the school of Rav Ada, or, alternatively, Mar bar Rav Ada’s school. Yuchasin read “bar Rav Ada bar Ahava,” a very sound reading: Rav Chiyya bar Avin says there, “I asked Rav Ada bar Ahava.” The unqualified Rav Ada did not live in their generation; Rav Ada bar Ahava did.

notes.text: Shabbat 140a explicitly supplies the consultation with Rav Ada bar Ahava. Hyman uses it to argue for Yuchasin’s expanded name; this is his chronological argument.
